newsitem.title: THAILAND: Dynamic shareholders approve share issue.
newsitem.headline: Dynamic shareholders approve share issue.

text.p: Shareholders of Thai broker Dynamic Eastern Finance Thailand (1991) Plc have approved its plans to raise an additional one billion baht ($38.5 million) in share capital, the firm said on Monday.
The plan to raise capital was announced last month.

Shareholders voted to offer 50 million new shares at not less than their 10 baht par value to the central bank within the next six months. A further issue of 50 million new shares would take place within three years from March 3, 1997, the statement said.
The combined issues will take the firm's registered capital to 2.78 billion baht from 1.78 billion baht, the firm said.
Offer terms for the second 50 million share tranche would be determined closer to the issue date, the company said.

Dynamic Eastern is one of 10 Thai finance and securities firms ordered by the central bank in March to increase their registered share capital immediately to boost their financial resources in the face of a deteriorating operating environment.

Slowing economic growth, high borrowing costs, deteriorating loan quality and portfolio losses on securities trading have caused a liquidity squeeze among several Thai brokers and raised investor concerns about the sector's financial stability.

The central bank's Financial Institutions Rehabilitation Fund has guaranteed that it will buy stakes in the 10 firms, either at their request, or if their new share issues could not be sold. ($1 = 26 baht)
